independent_source_issues.topic: Convexity, uniqueness and moving inactive points
independent_source_issues.finding: Hard-margin uniqueness relies on the stated separable two-class setup, not convexity alone; cannot generalize to all dual coefficients or soft-margin intercepts. Removing strictly inactive constraints differs from arbitrarily moving their points: moving across a margin can make them active and change the solution.
independent_source_issues.translation_action: Source limitation retained faithfully; no required translation correction

independent_source_issues.finding: Boundary-only equality y*f=1 describes part of support vectors; soft-margin points with0<alpha<=C may lie inside the margin or be misclassified. Doc finder only abs(margin-1)<tol and may miss violating supports or find none after approximate training. Active boundary constraints can have zero multipliers in degenerate solutions.
independent_source_issues.translation_action: Source limitation retained faithfully; no required translation correction

independent_source_issues.finding: Kernel prediction typically stores supports and coefficients; linear SVM/logistic prediction can both use w,b only. Hinge sparsity is primarily dual-coefficient sparsity, not necessarily sparse primal weights. Number of support vectors may approach n.
independent_source_issues.translation_action: Source limitation retained faithfully; no required translation correction

independent_source_issues.finding: Slack penalizes functional-margin violation rather than exactly the0-1 misclassification count. Large/small C do not guarantee over/underfit. The summed-loss C objective and mean-loss lambda objective use lambda=1/(n*C), not simply1/C absent normalization.
independent_source_issues.translation_action: Source limitation retained faithfully; no required translation correction

independent_source_issues.finding: Hinge is nondifferentiable at margin1; code chooses a valid zero hinge subgradient there. Displayed formulas are per-example (sub)gradients although L includes the mean over n. Implementation uses cyclic online updates with constant learning rate, not full-batch gradient descent or a convergence guarantee. O(nd) describes dense pass, not sparse-efficient storage implementation.
independent_source_issues.translation_action: Source limitation retained faithfully; no required translation correction

independent_source_issues.finding: A valid positive-semidefinite kernel and parameter restrictions are needed; gamma>0 and polynomial degree/nonnegative offset conditions are not stated. RBF closeness depends on gamma and input scaling. Universal approximation is not exact learning of every smooth boundary with finite data; O(D^d) feature count statement assumes fixed degree and homogeneous/inhomogeneous conventions.
independent_source_issues.translation_action: Source limitation retained faithfully; no required translation correction

independent_source_issues.finding: Constraints use deviation<=epsilon on each side, so total vertical tube width is2epsilon, despite source width epsilon. Tube lies around prediction function rather than each observation. Support vectors can lie on the tube boundaries as well as outside; wider tube/fewer supports/smoother fit is not an unconditional identity.
independent_source_issues.translation_action: Source limitation retained faithfully; no required translation correction
